fields.name: HostId
fields.description: ID of the saved SSH host to connect to (from sshmanager.host_list)

fields.name: Card
fields.description: Optional raw markdown of a type: crawl definition card (frontmatter + body). Only for workflow/persistent crawls; prefer Config for quick crawls.

fields.name: Config
fields.description: Inline crawl configuration — sufficient on its own, no card required. Seeds (list of start URLs) is the only mandatory value; set InstanceID to reuse a mounted independent browser window. Others: MaxPages (default 100), MaxDepth (default 0, seed pages only), SameDomain, RateLimit (duration string e.g. "500ms"), Mode (hidden_window | performance), Profile, ExtractSchema (v1: BrowserCrawlPageResult), ExtractSelectors.

fields.name: Overrides
fields.description: Optional highest-priority merge over Card/Config before snapshotting; card-data keys in snake_case (e.g. same_domain).

fields.name: Enabled
fields.description: Whether the LSP service is enabled for this language.

fields.name: BundleIDs
fields.description: Full replacement list of mountable card IDs (builtin:bundle:*, app-bundle:*, mcp:* server cards, project cards). Empty array clears the defaults. Affects only agents spawned afterwards.

fields.name: NoGitMode
fields.description: true = workflows run without git worktree isolation (owner works directly in the project root); false = restore worktree-backed workflows.

fields.name: ForceRefresh
fields.description: Re-generate even if a ready snapshot exists.

fields.name: TestCommand
fields.description: Optional shell command for test execution during freeze. Empty = skip tests. Human callers only.

fields.name: FilePath
fields.description: File path within the child's worktree.

fields.name: Offset
fields.description: Line offset (1-based) for pagination. Omit for start of file.

fields.name: Name
fields.description: Deprecated; ignored. The worktree name/branch is always <callerID>-<random> (per-agent exclusive, never collides).

fields.name: BaseRef
fields.description: commit-ish the new branch starts from; empty = HEAD.

fields.name: Mode
fields.description: discard | merge. discard deletes the worktree; merge lands its branch on the main repo's base branch.

fields.name: Force
fields.description: discard only: required when the worktree has uncommitted changes.

fields.name: BaseBranch
fields.description: merge only: target branch in the main repo; empty = repo default (main/master).

callables.name: open_ssh_session
callables.description: Open an interactive SSH shell session on a remote host. Before opening, check sshmanager.session_list for an existing session on the same host and reuse its sessionId with sshmanager.shell_run — do not open duplicate sessions. The desktop right panel opens a terminal tab bound to the session. Returns the session ID for shell_input/shell_stream calls. Only available in the desktop client; in headless mode the session is created but no terminal tab appears.

callables.name: skill_use
callables.description: Invoke a mounted skill by skillId and receive its workflow instructions. The skill must be mounted first; each skill can be used at most once per session.

callables.name: rollup
callables.description: Run one aistats retention rollup round: roll raw records older than aistats_raw_days into daily documents, and complete daily months older than aistats_daily_days into permanent monthly documents. dryRun reports without writing or deleting; onlyDay forces a single YYYY-MM-DD day.

callables.name: app_export
callables.description: Export a project app as a signed, installable zip package: app.manifest.json, modules, assets, schema descriptors (app.descriptors.json), and for native runtimes abi.json plus the single native binary — with an Ed25519 signature (PACKAGE.sig / PACKAGE.pub, base64) over the canonical package hash. ProjectId is optional for agent callers: leave it empty and the host resolves your bound project from the injected CallerAgentId (same contract as register_project); never transcribe the id from prompt text. Returns the zip bytes, the package hash, and the base64 public key; the caller persists PackageData itself (e.g. via project.write). The exported zip installs through appmanager.install_local.

callables.name: callable_info
callables.description: Return the plugin dev callable reference: entries of callable id + description for the appmanager dev-loop surface, filterable by Query substring. Read-only.

callables.name: component_get
callables.description: Get a single virtual app-bundle component descriptor by cardId (app-bundle:<...>). Use it to inspect an app-exposed bundle's tools and dependencies before mounting it.

callables.name: component_list
callables.description: List every virtual app-bundle component currently projected by the running app registry. Each descriptor includes the cardId, title, icon, declared tools, and dependencies. Use this to discover which bundles each loaded app exposes for mounting. Read-only.

callables.name: dev_gate
callables.description: Run the five registration gates against a dev app without registering it: resolve the .appdef, temporarily load the artifact to verify coverage, and return a pass/fail report per gate. Diagnostic only — passing gates does not register the app; call register_project for that.

callables.name: dev_generate
callables.description: Generate app scaffolding from a .appdef declaration: handlers, schema types, server/client glue, and (for native plugins) the SDK vendor step. Regenerating overwrites generated files; keep hand-written code out of generated paths.

callables.name: dev_guide
callables.description: Return the structured plugin development guide by Topic: prerequisites, workflow (appdef → generate → implement → gate → register), host_api (plugin-side host calls), security, common errors. Omit Topic for the full guide. Read-only.

callables.name: get
callables.description: Get one registered app's AppStatus by ID (manifest id/name/version/runtime plus live record state).

callables.name: host_protocol
callables.description: Query the plugin-reachable host capability surface: grantable capabilities, the SDK host callIDs they gate, and request/response type names with schema IDs. Read-only discovery for the declare-then-extract flow (appdef permissions -> dev_generate hostproto.gen.go).

callables.name: icon_names
callables.description: List valid icon names for card/bundle visual fields (data.icon, data.visual.icon) with labels, keywords, and categories. Optional Query substring or Category exact filter. Use before setting icons on bundle cards or app visuals.

callables.name: install_local
callables.description: Install an app from a local package: Path (a directory or zip path) or PackageData (raw zip bytes). A zip must carry app.manifest.json at its root and, when the app declares schemas, app.descriptors.json (the typed-callable descriptors the host protocol registry needs — an export always carries it); when PACKAGE.sig/PACKAGE.pub are present the Ed25519 signature is verified against the recomputed canonical package hash and a tampered package is rejected before any load. After verification the package is loaded and registered, invocable like any register_project app.

callables.name: invoke
callables.description: Invoke a callable exposed by a registered app: routes Id + Callable + Payload (raw JSON) through the app's own runtime (spore child or native plugin process) and returns the app's response.

callables.name: list
callables.description: List registered apps as AppStatus entries (manifest id/name/version/runtime plus live record state), sorted by id. Read-only.

callables.name: open_view
callables.description: Mount an app's view panel in the right panel, identical to a user clicking the app tile (ViewId optional, defaults to the first view entrypoint). Precondition for any frontend signal: while no panel is mounted there is no iframe, no bridge session, and pluginhost.plugin_dom / plugin_logs see nothing. Prefer this over open_global_browser for showing a plugin panel — the browser bypasses the plugin bridge.

callables.name: panel_topology
callables.description: Read-only runtime topology diagnostic for a plugin panel: gateway base URL, the exact panel route /plugin/{id}/{route}?v={gen}, the plugin process's loopback listener address, and what each 401/404 on those hops means (auth working vs misconfigured). Replaces netstat port-scanning when a panel will not load.

callables.name: plugin_load
callables.description: Load a registered native plugin's artifact (native runtime only): starts the process / maps the artifact, routes its callables, and returns AppStatus. Already-live records self-heal routing; an unloaded in-process plugin stages restart_pending (activates on next host restart).

callables.name: plugin_unload
callables.description: Unload a registered native plugin (native runtime only): unloads the pluginhost artifact and marks the record unloaded. A failed unload lands in unload_failed and can be retried by calling again; the registration stays for plugin_load.

callables.name: register
callables.description: Register an app from an in-memory package (Manifest + EntryModule + Modules source map): validates the manifest and modules, runs the registration pipeline (policy, protocol, persistence), then starts the spore child or loads the native artifact.

callables.name: register_project
callables.description: Register a dev-built app from the current project directory into the host app registry (dev loop step: appdef -> dev_generate -> implement handlers -> register_project -> open_view). Irreversible per run; use reload_project to pick up source changes.

callables.name: registration_preview
callables.description: Resolve the manifest a pending registration would install (register / register_project / install_local / content_install source), read-only: no build, load, or persistence. Used by the permission panel to show the requested host capabilities before approval.

callables.name: reload
callables.description: Swap a running app to a new artifact version in place: validates, restarts the spore child (or reloads the native plugin artifact), audits the caller, and records success or failure. Plugins self-heal a wedged record.

callables.name: reload_project
callables.description: Reload a project-registered dev app: rebuild the artifact from the project sources and restart its runtime in place.

callables.name: retry_cleanup
callables.description: Idempotently finish or retry an app unregister that failed midway: completes the pending back-half cleanup when the record is in cleanup_pending, or retries the full unregister from unload_failed/unloading. Returns completed | failed | not_pending | not_found.

callables.name: sdk_vendor
callables.description: Vendor the plugin SDK into the app directory (vendor-sdk/) and re-point go.mod at it, making the app buildable with zero host-machine dependencies. Template scaffolds vendor automatically; use this for existing apps or to refresh a stale vendored copy. Idempotent; re-running replaces vendor-sdk with the current host SDK.

callables.name: unregister
callables.description: Unregister an app by ID: stop its runtime and remove the record. A failure mid-way leaves the record in cleanup_pending — finish it with appmanager.retry_cleanup.

callables.name: use
callables.description: Drive a browser instance by action name (observe, navigate, click, type, ...). InstanceID defaults to "global" — the shared desktop browser session. Read-only observe actions return the page state; interactive actions re-observe after acting so each response carries the updated page state (observe → act closed loop).

callables.name: session_token
callables.description: Return a fresh cloud access token for host-internal callers (e.g. plugin-store downloads). Refreshes first when near expiry; empty token when no account is linked.

callables.name: sync
callables.description: Force an immediate token-refresh + entitlements re-fetch from the cloud and return the resulting status

callables.name: capabilities
callables.description: Report the platform capability matrix: which features, interact actions, OCR engines and gated callables are supported on this host

callables.name: clipboard_get
callables.description: Read the system clipboard text [gated scope: computeruse.clipboard_read]

callables.name: clipboard_get_rich
callables.description: Read the system clipboard in all available formats (text/image/files/html) [gated scope: computeruse.clipboard_read]

callables.name: clipboard_set
callables.description: Write text to the system clipboard [gated scope: computeruse.clipboard_write]

callables.name: clipboard_set_rich
callables.description: Write a typed payload (image/files/html/text) to the system clipboard [gated scope: computeruse.clipboard_write]

callables.name: cursor_position
callables.description: Return the current cursor position

callables.name: get_window_info
callables.description: Return detailed info for one window

callables.name: interact
callables.description: Perform mouse / keyboard / window actions on the computer [gated scope: computeruse.input_control]

callables.name: list_displays
callables.description: List connected displays

callables.name: list_elements
callables.description: Enumerate UI Automation elements under a window (or desktop)

callables.name: list_processes
callables.description: List OS processes (optionally filtered by name/pid)

callables.name: list_windows
callables.description: List top-level windows (with optional filters)

callables.name: ocr
callables.description: Run OCR over a screen region and return recognised text

callables.name: screenshot
callables.description: Capture a screenshot of the screen for LLM analysis

callables.name: setup_ocr
callables.description: Download or verify PaddleOCR model files and ONNX runtime for embedded OCR [dedicated computeruse_setup lane: writes durable OCR state]

callables.name: stream
callables.description: Continuous low-bandwidth tile-diff capture of a display/region/window [gated scope: computeruse.continuous_capture]

callables.name: pairing_info
callables.description: Return the Cookie Bridge loopback endpoints (MCP URL, extension push/poll URLs) and pairing token. For pairing the Chrome extension and configuring the MCP server row; the token is a local secret — paste it only into the extension and the MCP server config.

callables.name: regen_token
callables.description: Mint a fresh Cookie Bridge pairing token. The previous token stops working immediately; re-pair the Chrome extension and update the MCP server Authorization header afterwards.

callables.name: cancel
callables.description: Cancel a crawl task by TaskId. A running engine stops after the current page; a task suspended on a login wall (awaiting_login) also releases its hidden browser window.

callables.name: handoff
callables.description: Open a visible, user-controllable browser window sharing the crawl task's hidden profile so the user can complete a login wall. Only valid while the task is in the awaiting_login state; after login the crawl resumes on the authenticated session.

callables.name: results
callables.description: Fetch a crawl task's collected pages (URL, Title, Links, extracted Text), cursor-paginated (Cursor → NextCursor, default limit 50). Done=true when the crawl is finished and all pages have been read.

callables.name: start
callables.description: Start a browser crawl task from an inline Config (seeds, mode, max pages, scope rules) — no card needed — or from a saved crawl card plus overrides. Returns the crawl TaskID; the crawl runs asynchronously — poll crawl.status and page through crawl.results.

callables.name: status
callables.description: Get a crawl task's state (running / awaiting_login / done / failed / cancelled), crawled and frontier page counts, max pages, and the error string when failed.

callables.name: edit
callables.description: Edit an existing file by replacing text. Use as the sole modification channel.

callables.name: glob
callables.description: Find files matching a glob pattern.

callables.name: grep
callables.description: Search files for a pattern. Default output_mode is files.

callables.name: list
callables.description: List directory contents as plain text (one entry per line, directories end with /). Depth controls how many levels to descend: 0 or omit for current directory only, 1 for one level, 2 for two levels, -1 for full recursion. Skips node_modules, .git, vendor, dist, build. Hidden entries (names starting with '.') are omitted by default.

callables.name: list_json
callables.description: List directory contents as JSON entries. Depth controls how many levels to descend: 0 or omit for current directory only, 1 for one level, 2 for two levels, -1 for full recursion. Skips node_modules, .git, vendor, dist, build. Hidden entries (names starting with '.') are omitted by default.

callables.name: read
callables.description: Read a text file

callables.name: read_base64
callables.description: Read a file as base64

callables.name: read_chunk
callables.description: Read a chunk of a file

callables.name: rm
callables.description: Remove files or directories. Directories require recursive=true.

callables.name: roots
callables.description: List browsable filesystem roots: the user home directory and every volume root (drive letters on Windows, "/" elsewhere). Used by the web/mobile file picker, which has no native folder dialog and cannot enumerate volumes client-side.

callables.name: write
callables.description: Create a new file. Rejects if file already exists.

callables.name: write_base64
callables.description: Write a file from base64-encoded content, overwriting any existing file. Use for binary files (images, archives) that cannot be expressed as text.

callables.name: control
callables.description: Drive the interface via an Action parameter: set_view (Mode: conversation|topology|files|problems|notes|ssh|multiconsole), open_settings (Category), switch_project (ProjectId), focus_agent (AgentId), anchor_catalog (list addressable UI anchors before composing a guide), show_guide (Steps with whitelist-validated TargetGuideId), hide_guide, interact (GuideId + Interaction: click|focus|input|scroll_into_view on data-guide-id annotated elements), create_tutorial (Title + Steps, optional TutorialId slug / Description / AutoPlay; upserts into the persisted tutorial library, max 32 tutorials of ≤12 steps each), delete_tutorial (TutorialId), tutorial_catalog (list persisted tutorials, no event). Fire-and-forget: verify effects via query_interactions.

callables.name: query_interactions
callables.description: Read user (or remote-action) UI interactions from the 500-entry ring buffer. Optional filters: Since (RFC3339), GuideId, Kind (click|input|navigate|guide_error|remote_ack|guide_progress), Limit (default 50, max 200). Returns records newest-first. Use to verify the effect of interfacemanager.control actions.

callables.name: clear_cache
callables.description: Shut down every LSP server and free all cached analysis data. Servers are re-created lazily on the next lsp.initialize.

callables.name: code_action
callables.description: Get code actions for a range.

callables.name: completion
callables.description: Get completion items at a position.

callables.name: definition
callables.description: Go to definition at a position.

callables.name: did_change
callables.description: Notify the server that a document changed.

callables.name: did_close
callables.description: Notify the server that a document was closed.

callables.name: did_open
callables.description: Notify the server that a document was opened.

callables.name: document_symbol
callables.description: Get document symbols for a file.

callables.name: formatting
callables.description: Format a document.

callables.name: hover
callables.description: Get hover information at a position.

callables.name: implementation
callables.description: Find implementations at a position.

callables.name: initialize
callables.description: Initialize the LSP server for a workspace root and language.

callables.name: install
callables.description: Trigger an async managed download of the language server for a language. Returns immediately; progress streams via lsp.install_progress events and the final state is visible via lsp.status.

callables.name: prepare_rename
callables.description: Prepare a rename at a position.

callables.name: references
callables.description: Find references at a position.

callables.name: rename
callables.description: Rename the symbol at a position.

callables.name: shutdown
callables.description: Shut down the LSP server for a workspace root and language (all languages if language is empty, all servers if rootUri is empty).

callables.name: shutdown_by_root
callables.description: Shut down every language server whose workspace root URI decodes to a path at or under RootPath. Internal: used to release LSP process handles before worktree directory deletion.

callables.name: signature_help
callables.description: Get signature help at a position.

callables.name: state_get
callables.description: Get the LSP service enabled state.

callables.name: state_save
callables.description: Enable or disable the LSP service for a language. When disabled, all running language engines are shut down and new lsp.initialize calls are refused.

callables.name: status
callables.description: Report per-language language-server install state (managed downloads and native PATH discovery). Empty language reports every supported language.

callables.name: type_definition
callables.description: Go to type definition at a position.

callables.name: warm_up
callables.description: Preload the package containing a document so subsequent queries are memory-fast.

callables.name: add_server
callables.description: Register a new MCP server in the system registry. The server auto-connects when Enabled is true, after which its tools become discoverable and it appears as the mountable bundle card mcp:<server-id>. Secrets passed in Stdio.Env / Http.Headers are write-only: accepted here, never returned by any callable. Only add a server when the user asks for it.

callables.name: call_tool
callables.description: Invoke a tool on a configured MCP server: Id selects the server, Tool the tool name, Arguments carries the JSON arguments. Exposed by the builtin:bundle:sporecall bundle.

callables.name: list_servers
callables.description: List every MCP server configured in the system, with id, name, transport, enabled flag, and live status (connected, toolCount, error). Safe view: env/header key names only, never values. Each server is mountable on an agent as the bundle card mcp:<server-id>.

callables.name: reconnect
callables.description: Force-reconnect an MCP server: tear down any live session, reset the auto-reconnect budget, and establish a fresh connection (a plain connect is a no-op while the instance still reports connected). Agent-facing so a mounted agent can self-heal a dropped server; returns the live status.

callables.name: list_plugins
callables.description: List loaded native plugins: id, name, version, runtime/ABI, capabilities, callable ids, trust class, and status (loading | active | error | unloaded, with Error text on transient invoke failures). Read-only.

callables.name: panel_op
callables.description: Run a precise operation on a mounted dev-registered plugin panel: Op=dom|eval|click|type|wait (dom: serialize DOM with [k] action markers; eval: run bounded async JS and return JSON; click/type: target a CSS selector; wait: await a selector/text). Requires a plugin registered via the dev loop.

callables.name: plugin_dom
callables.description: Request a plugin panel's serialized DOM: asks the mounted iframe through the bridge port to serialize, then waits for the webview push. Use it for layout and rendering diagnosis (structure, not pixels).

callables.name: plugin_logs
callables.description: Fetch a plugin's captured logs: newest backend and frontend console ring entries, plus the inferred process verdict (running/stopped/crashed with crash cause). Read-only; use it when a plugin misbehaves.

callables.name: configure
callables.description: Configure the policy judge: backend mode (auto | jev | llm), Jev API key/model/endpoint, and the LLM fallback ModelUnit. Jev.ApiKey empty preserves the stored key (redacted edit flow).

callables.name: decide
callables.description: Evaluate typed questions (Choice/Score/Noul) against a text state and return typed answers with probabilities, confidence, and backend provenance (jev | llm; llm answers are marked Calibrated=false). All questions are evaluated in one batch. Failover between backends happens on availability faults only; when all backends fail the response carries Error with empty Answers — fall back to your own rules then.

callables.name: archive_export
callables.description: Pack a source path into a base64 tar.gz archive. The source may be a regular file (the archive then contains exactly one entry named path.Base(source)) or a directory (recursively packed, top-level entry is the directory's base name). Only regular files and directories are carried; symlinks and other special files are skipped. The archive is capped at 50 MiB compressed, 500 MiB uncompressed and 10000 entries. The source path resolves within the project root scope.

callables.name: archive_import
callables.description: Safely extract a base64 tar.gz archive into a target directory. Rejects symlinks, hard links, absolute paths, ".." traversal, duplicate entries and conflicts with existing regular files (safe merge). Capped at 50 MiB compressed, 500 MiB uncompressed and 10000 entries. The target path resolves within the project root scope.

callables.name: component_get
callables.description: Get a MonoCard-backed component descriptor.

callables.name: component_list
callables.description: List MonoCard-backed prompt, tool, skill, mode, and capability components.

callables.name: default_bundles_get
callables.description: Get the project-level default extra bundle card IDs merged into every spawn_agent request (applies to agents and sub-agents created under this project).

callables.name: default_bundles_set
callables.description: Set the project-level default extra bundle card IDs. spawn_agent merges these (deduped, before caller-supplied extras) into ExtraBundleIDs so new agents and sub-agents mount them by default.

callables.name: edit
callables.description: Edit an existing file by replacing exact old_string text with new_string. By default, old_string must be non-empty, differ from new_string, and occur exactly once; use replace_all=true only when every occurrence should change. If old_string is not found, re-read the file and use the exact current text. Use overwrite=true to replace the entire existing file, or project.write to create a missing file. Errors are prefixed with project.edit; successful edits return replacement counts and hunks.

callables.name: git_add
callables.description: Stage files in the repository. Pass explicit paths rather than staging everything.

callables.name: git_branch
callables.description: List repository branches (local and remote) with the current-branch marker.

callables.name: git_checkout
callables.description: Switch to a branch. Use create=true to create and switch. Rewrites the working tree — never checkout another branch in the user's main worktree without an explicit request.

callables.name: git_commit
callables.description: Commit staged changes in the caller's bound worktree and return the new hash (empty Message defaults to "worktree commit"). Stage explicit paths with git_add first.

callables.name: git_diff
callables.description: Show changes for a file in the repository this git call operates on. Repo "" (default) selects the caller's bound worktree when attached, else the main repo; Repo "main" forces the main repo root (root agents only).

callables.name: git_log
callables.description: Show commit history for the repository this git call operates on. Repo "" (default) selects the caller's bound worktree when attached, else the main repo; Repo "main" forces the main repo root (root agents only).

callables.name: git_pull
callables.description: Pull from the named remote into the current branch.

callables.name: git_push
callables.description: Push commits to a remote.

callables.name: git_stash_list
callables.description: List stashes of the repository this git call operates on. Repo "" (default) selects the caller's bound worktree when attached, else the main repo; Repo "main" forces the main repo root (root agents only).

callables.name: git_stash_pop
callables.description: Restore a stash into the repository this git call operates on. Repo "" (default) selects the caller's bound worktree when attached, else the main repo; Repo "main" forces the main repo root (root agents only).

callables.name: git_stash_save
callables.description: Stash the working tree changes (including untracked files) of the repository this git call operates on. Repo "" (default) selects the caller's bound worktree when attached, else the main repo; Repo "main" forces the main repo root (root agents only). Workflow owners use Repo "main" to clear uncommitted blockers reported by workflow_stop.

callables.name: git_status
callables.description: Show the working tree status of the repository this git call operates on. Repo "" (default) selects the caller's bound worktree when attached, else the main repo; Repo "main" forces the main repo root (root agents only). Workflow owners use Repo "main" to inspect blockers reported by workflow_stop.

callables.name: glob
callables.description: Find files by glob pattern (e.g. **/*.go). Skips node_modules, .git, vendor, dist, build and .gitignored entries by default. Set no_ignore=true to bypass all ignore layers.

callables.name: grep
callables.description: Search file contents with a Go-compatible regular expression. Returns matching file paths by default; use output_mode=content for lines or output_mode=count for per-file counts. An empty result is a successful search with no matches. Errors are prefixed with project.grep; invalid pattern means the regex could not be compiled. Skips node_modules, .git, vendor, dist, build and .gitignored entries by default; set no_ignore=true to bypass all ignore layers.

callables.name: list
callables.description: List directory contents as plain text (one entry per line, directories end with /). Depth controls how many levels to descend: 0 or omit for current directory only, 1 for one level, 2 for two levels, -1 for full recursion. Skips node_modules, .git, vendor, dist, build. Hidden entries (names starting with '.') are omitted by default. With detail=true each line appends mtime (YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS ±HH:MM) and, for files, Size:N.

callables.name: no_git_mode_get
callables.description: Get the project's no-git mode setting and whether the project root is an actual git repository.

callables.name: no_git_mode_set
callables.description: Set the project's no-git mode. When enabled, workflow activation skips owner-worktree creation and all downstream git operations are skipped via the empty-worktree-ID branch.

callables.name: read
callables.description: Read a file with optional line offset/limit, tail (last N lines), and an in-file regex filter. Prefer it over shell cat; use offset/limit or tail for large files.

callables.name: review_changeset
callables.description: Generate or retrieve a frozen, read-only changeset summary for a workflow child agent's worktree. Includes baseline/HEAD, commit list, tracked file status with diff metadata, untracked file summaries, rename/deletion detection, binary/generated markers, and test results. Only the child's direct parent agent or a trusted human/admin may call this.

callables.name: review_changeset_clear
callables.description: Internal: drop the cached changeset for an agent. Called by workspace after approve/reject to free memory.

callables.name: review_changeset_finalize
callables.description: Internal: apply the async generation result on the project owner loop. Called by the goroutine via self-invoke.

callables.name: review_changeset_freeze
callables.description: Internal: kick off async changeset generation for a workflow child agent entering pending_review. Registers a preparing placeholder immediately and launches a background goroutine. Called by the agent's turn engine, not directly by LLMs.

callables.name: review_file_content
callables.description: Read paginated file content from a frozen review changeset. For tracked modified files, returns the unified diff; for untracked files, returns the full content. Large outputs are paginated via Offset/Limit.

callables.name: rm
callables.description: Remove a file or directory. Two-phase by default: without Confirm/Force it returns a Preview of what would be removed; the actual delete happens only with Confirm=true (or Force). Directories additionally require Recursive=true. Irreversible.

callables.name: shell_exec
callables.description:
Execute a command in the project directory. External binaries run via the system shell.

Timeout is in milliseconds; default 30000 (30s). Values below 1000 are clamped to the default. Larger values are allowed, so long-running commands can request more time explicitly.

callables.name: task_validate_outputs
callables.description: Validate a worker's produced outputs against a task card's data.outputs contract. A card with no data.outputs is always valid. Used by the review path before approving.

callables.name: watch_file
callables.description: Add (Remove=false) or drop (Remove=true) an on-demand watch for a single file. The file watcher only watches the .sporecode subtree plus on-demand files; UI surfaces that need file_changed events for a file outside it (e.g. an open file viewer) must call this with the file's path. The parent directory is watched and shared between viewers, so add and remove calls must be paired.

callables.name: wiki_automation_bind
callables.description: Bind a workflow template to a scheduler card: snapshots a workflow map into a template (tpl::<MapId>) and writes the template id onto the scheduler card so subsequent timer fires instantiate fresh workflow instances instead of submitting the card body.

callables.name: wiki_claim_task_card
callables.description: Atomically claim a task card (CAS status from an expected set) and return the saved raw in one round trip. Fuses the spawn_assign/agent_assign claim sequence.

callables.name: wiki_close_card
callables.description: Close a card from the story river (remove if present).

callables.name: wiki_create_card
callables.description: Create a project wiki card. Required: Id, Raw (full markdown including frontmatter). Validate with wiki_validate_card when unsure; for map/task cards use the specialized wiki_create_map / wiki_create_task_card callables instead.

callables.name: wiki_create_map
callables.description: Create a root map card (type=map) with correct frontmatter and a body template. Id becomes the card id verbatim, so name it after the workflow's goal in a few kebab- or snake-case words (e.g. react-appdef-refactor), not an opaque code; keep it under 200 bytes. Replaces hand-written YAML for workflow maps.

callables.name: wiki_create_task_card
callables.description: Create a task card under a map, atomically append its id to the map's include list, and optionally wire depends_on edges. Title becomes the card id verbatim, so make it describe the deliverable in a few kebab- or snake-case words (e.g. adopt-orphan-task-cards), not a bare sequence number like t3; keep it under 200 bytes. Replaces the error-prone two-step manual process.

callables.name: wiki_delete_card
callables.description: Delete a wiki card by id. Protected cards (builtin:*, __builtin_*__) are rejected.

callables.name: wiki_edit_card
callables.description: Edit an existing wiki card: full raw replacement (Raw) or frontmatter-preserving body patch (OldString + NewString). In patch mode a no-op and ambiguous OldString are rejected; narrow the match or set ReplaceAll.

callables.name: wiki_frontier
callables.description: Return the deterministic frontier for a workflow map: task cards that are unclaimed (status backlog/todo) and whose all depends_on dependencies are done.

callables.name: wiki_get_card
callables.description: Read a project wiki card by id: frontmatter fields plus the raw markdown body.

callables.name: wiki_get_card_hierarchy
callables.description: Explore the card hierarchy around a given card. Returns a tree string with parents (↑) and children (↓) up to the requested level.

callables.name: wiki_get_cards_batch
callables.description: Fetch raw mono cards by id list in one round trip. Missing cards return Found=false instead of an error.

callables.name: wiki_get_concept_tree
callables.description: Get a normalized concept tree projection on demand.

callables.name: wiki_get_starred
callables.description: Return the knowledge-base starred card ids for this project, most-recently-starred first. Starred is UI-only state persisted in the project's .ropen record; it never rewrites the starred card.

callables.name: wiki_list_cards
callables.description: List project wiki cards. Tree mode (default): renders the hierarchy under RootId (default toc) as both an ASCII Tree and structured Nodes (id, type, status, modified for icon/click rendering); Depth/Limit/OrderBy cap and sort siblings. Flat mode (Flat=true): returns a flat array of cards with IncludeRaw/IncludeBuiltin/WorkflowFilter options, plus title Query and metadata filters (tags, status, type, source, list, parent, priority, due, time windows), sorted by OrderBy (default -modified), paginated by Limit (default 50), and Total count when Total=true. Workspace agent instance cards (agent:*) are hidden by default; include them via Type="agent", Source="workspace", or IncludeBuiltin=true.

callables.name: wiki_list_dependencies
callables.description: List task-card data.depends_on edges (optionally filtered to one workflow map).

callables.name: wiki_list_template_runs
callables.description: Return the most recent instantiation runs of a workflow template map, newest first.

callables.name: wiki_list_templates
callables.description: List all workflow template map cards (data.template:true) in the project. Used by the scheduler editor's template selector.

callables.name: wiki_list_timers
callables.description: List all scheduled timer cards and their next fire times.

callables.name: wiki_open_card
callables.description: Open a card in the story river (prepend, idempotent).

callables.name: wiki_promote_node_outputs
callables.description: Promote a task node's persisted outputs into the map-level inputs table (channel c of typed-inputs). Used after an intake grilling node is reviewed and its outputs are persisted — the node's output field names become map-level input keys.

callables.name: wiki_search_card_content
callables.description: Search project mono cards by body content (substring or /regexp/) with the same metadata filters as search_cards (tags, status, type, source, list, parent, priority, due, modified/created/due time windows) plus optional OrderBy. Returns matching cards with a snippet and line number of the first match, and an untruncated Total. Use this to find which cards mention a concept; use search_cards for title/metadata queries.

callables.name: wiki_set_map_inputs
callables.description: Set the map-level inputs table for a workflow map (channel a of typed-inputs). The caller parses startup/intake text into key-value pairs and writes them here; downstream tasks consume them via data-flow bindings whose FromNode is "$map".

callables.name: wiki_set_map_owner
callables.description: Bind an agent to a workflow map or task card by stamping ownerAgentId into its Data block. Map cards enforce single-binding; task cards allow overwrite (CAS guards ownership).

callables.name: wiki_set_starred
callables.description: Star or un-star a knowledge-base card by id (idempotent). Returns the updated starred list, most-recently-starred first. Does not modify the card itself.

callables.name: wiki_set_status
callables.description: Atomically update a card's frontmatter status field without a full Raw rewrite. Lightweight path for programmatic status transitions.

callables.name: wiki_set_task_dependencies
callables.description: Replace a task card's data.depends_on list after validating its workflow scope.

callables.name: wiki_set_task_outputs
callables.description: Persist a worker's produced outputs onto a task card's data.task_outputs block so downstream tasks can resolve them via data bindings. Called by the review-approve path.

callables.name: wiki_template_instantiate
callables.description: Copy a template map (data.template:true) into a new runnable instance map. Node ids are remapped under the instance prefix; each task card is stamped data.instance_of and given status:backlog + a depends_on projection from the instance graph. Atomic: on failure all created cards are rolled back.

callables.name: wiki_template_save
callables.description: Snapshot a workflow map's topology graph + task cards into a new template map (data.template:true). Runtime fields (status, owner, task_outputs, depends_on projection) are stripped; node ids are remapped under the template prefix.

callables.name: wiki_toggle_timer
callables.description: Enable or disable a scheduled timer card.

callables.name: wiki_trigger_timer_card
callables.description: Trigger a scheduled wiki card immediately without changing its schedule.

callables.name: wiki_unbind_agent
callables.description: Internal: invoked by the workspace agent-deletion path when an agent is destroyed, so the project can clear the deleted agent's id from every card it was bound to (data.ownerAgentId), returning those cards to the unbound state.

callables.name: wiki_validate_card
callables.description: Validate a card's raw markdown without persisting it. Returns structured validation errors.

callables.name: workflow_create_worktree
callables.description: Internal: create a workflow owner worktree and bind the owner agent. Called by agent actor during activateWorkflow.

callables.name: workflow_stop_merge_worktree
callables.description: Internal: merge a workflow owner worktree into the main repo's base branch. Called by agent actor during clearWorkflow.

callables.name: workflow_worktree_clean_check
callables.description: Internal: check whether an agent's bound worktree has uncommitted changes. Called during workflow teardown.

callables.name: worktree_agent_bindings
callables.description: List all agent→worktree bindings for topology visibility, discard safety checks, and restart recovery.

callables.name: worktree_bound_check
callables.description: Internal: reports whether a given agent has an active worktree binding. Consumed by appmanager's dev surface so a caller bound to a worktree is routed to that worktree for dev_generate/dev_gate/register_project.

callables.name: worktree_copy
callables.description: Copy files from the main repo root into the caller's bound worktree. Sources are relative to the main repo root; DestDir is relative to the worktree root and defaults to the worktree root itself. Existing destination files are only overwritten when Force=true.

callables.name: worktree_create
callables.description: Create a linked git worktree for isolated agent operations. Requires a name; creates a branch and checks out into .git/wt/<id>.

callables.name: worktree_discard
callables.description: Discard (remove) a worktree. If the worktree has uncommitted changes, set force=true to override.

callables.name: worktree_discard_by_id
callables.description: Internal: discard a worktree by ID with structured response. Called by workspace actor for orphan worktree cleanup.

callables.name: worktree_enter
callables.description: Enter (self-bind) a per-agent exclusive worktree for this session. Idempotent: returns the current binding if already bound. Name is ignored; the worktree is named after the caller to enforce one-agent-one-worktree isolation.

callables.name: worktree_exit
callables.description: Leave the caller's worktree and return to the main repo.

callables.name: worktree_get
callables.description: Get a worktree by ID.

callables.name: worktree_list
callables.description: List all worktrees tracked by this project.

callables.name: worktree_merge_to_parent
callables.description: Internal: merge a child worktree into its parent worktree. Called by workspace actor during review approve.

callables.name: worktree_rebase_to_parent
callables.description: Internal: rebase a child worktree onto its parent worktree's branch HEAD. Called by workspace actor during review reject.

callables.name: worktree_release_binding
callables.description: Internal: invoked by workspace.delete_agent when an agent is destroyed, so the project can drop the agent→worktree binding and remove the worktree if no other agent remains bound.

callables.name: worktree_verify_merged_to_parent
callables.description: Internal: verify a child worktree is already merged into its parent and clean it up if so. Called by workspace actor during review approve lineage check.

callables.name: write
callables.description: Create or overwrite a file within a configured root.

callables.name: edit
callables.description: Apply a whitelisted edit command (set_node_name, set_node_enabled, set_node_z, set_node_mesh, generate_node_mesh, param_create, param_update, param_remove, set_param_value, set_param_binding) to the puppet document, appending an immutable revision

callables.name: asset_reject
callables.description: Agent Act: reject staged asset; requires agent role and audited target envelope

callables.name: asset_stage
callables.description: Agent Act: stage asset for review; does not commit

callables.name: edit
callables.description: Agent Act: whitelisted draft edit only; requires agent role and audited target envelope

callables.name: revert_to
callables.description: Agent Act: revert document to a historical revision; requires agent role and audited target envelope

callables.name: capture
callables.description: Agent Explore: viewport capture as document reprojection; requires agent role and audited target envelope

callables.name: query
callables.description: Agent Explore: parameterized node query with whitelisted filters (kind, name pattern, texture, mesh); read-only projection

callables.name: snapshot
callables.description: Agent Explore: document snapshot; requires agent role and audited target envelope

callables.name: asset_list
callables.description: Agent Read: staged asset list; requires agent role and audited target envelope

callables.name: asset_read
callables.description: Agent Read: resolve committed asset to data URL; requires agent role and audited target envelope

callables.name: revision_log
callables.description: Agent Read: revision log; requires agent role and audited target envelope

callables.name: commit
callables.description: Commit a staged texture asset to an explicit target node

callables.name: list
callables.description: List staged, committed, or rejected puppet assets

callables.name: read
callables.description: Resolve a committed asset's DataRef to a loadable data URL (sha256-verified, no raw paths exposed)

callables.name: reject
callables.description: Reject a staged asset without changing the document

callables.name: stage
callables.description: Stage a texture or reference asset for review

callables.name: revert_to
callables.description: Rebuild the document to a historical revision as a new head revision (undo/redo); revision history is immutable and never deleted

callables.name: snapshot
callables.description: Read-only projection of the puppet document: the full node tree plus derived staging/revision counts

callables.name: list
callables.description: Read-only list of the document's animatable params and their node-property bindings

callables.name: log
callables.description: Immutable revision history (optionally limited to the most recent N)

callables.name: capture
callables.description: Canvas snapshot; while the canvas lives in the frontend this returns an honest document-level reprojection (svg), never a fabricated raster image

callables.name: bash
callables.description:
Execute a bash command in the project directory.

IMPORTANT: Avoid using this tool to run file operations that have dedicated tools. Instead, use the appropriate tool for better results:
- File search: use project.glob (NOT find or ls)
- Content search: use project.grep (NOT grep or rg)
- Read files: use project.read (NOT cat/head/tail)
- Edit files: use project.edit (NOT sed/awk)
- Write files: use project.write (NOT echo >)
- List directories: use project.list (NOT ls)

callables.name: exec
callables.description:
Execute a command. Built-in file commands (ls, cat, mkdir, rm, cp, mv, pwd, echo, write) run in a sandboxed VFS. Allowlisted external binaries (go, python, npm, git, make, etc.) run via the system shell. grep and find run as real system binaries. Dangerous commands (wget, nc, ssh, sudo, etc.) are blocked; curl is allowed.

For file operations, dedicated project tools are preferred:
- File search: use project.glob (NOT find)
- Content search: use project.grep (NOT grep)
- Read files: use project.read (NOT cat/head/tail)
- Edit files: use project.edit (NOT sed/awk)
- Write files: use project.write (NOT echo >)
- List directories: use project.list (NOT ls)

callables.name: session_close
callables.description: Close a shell session: kill the process, emit the terminal exit chunk, and release resources.

callables.name: session_fetch
callables.description: Replay a shell session's buffered output from FromIdx. Returns chunks with Idx >= FromIdx plus the next Idx to fetch from; Truncated is true when the ring buffer overwrote history so the window is non-contiguous. Lets a consumer that subscribed late or reconnected backfill the output it missed.

callables.name: session_open
callables.description: Open a persistent interactive shell session for the terminal panel. Launches the user's preferred shell (workspace shell preference, "" = auto) with PTY/ConPTY first and plain pipes as fallback. Returns a sessionId plus the effective Mode ("pty" or "pipe"); output arrives on the shell.session_output event and is filtered by sessionId. Close with shell.session_close when the terminal panel closes.

callables.name: session_resize
callables.description: Resize a shell session's pty window. No-op in pipe mode.

callables.name: session_write
callables.description: Write bytes to a shell session's stdin.

callables.name: sessions_close_by_path
callables.description: Close every interactive session whose working directory is at or under Path. Internal: used to release process handles before worktree directory deletion.

callables.name: archive_export
callables.description: Recursively archive a remote directory into a base64 tar.gz and return it

callables.name: archive_import
callables.description: Safely extract a base64 tar.gz into a remote directory

callables.name: download
callables.description: Download a remote file or directory from an SSH session. Auto-detects file vs directory: a file is returned as base64 bytes; a directory is archived into a tar.gz and returned as base64. The IsDirectory field in the response indicates which path was taken. Requires a sessionId from sshmanager.shell_open or an existing session.

callables.name: exec
callables.description: Run a command on a remote SSH host and return stdout/stderr/exit code. Connections are cached per (caller, host) and reused across calls; a dropped connection is re-established once. Timeout is in milliseconds; default 30000 (30s). Values below 1000 are clamped to the default; larger values are allowed.

callables.name: file_write_base64
callables.description: Decode base64 content and overwrite a remote file in the session

callables.name: host_list
callables.description: List saved SSH hosts (id, name, address, user, auth mode, groups). Non-admin callers see a redacted view (connection details blanked, agent-invisible hosts omitted). Resolve HostId here before shell/file operations.

callables.name: session_list
callables.description: List all currently open interactive SSH shell sessions. Call this BEFORE sshmanager.shell_open to find an existing session for the target host — reuse its sessionId with sshmanager.shell_run instead of opening a duplicate. Returns each session's SessionID, HostID, HostName, Connected, and Cwd.

callables.name: shell_open
callables.description: Open a new interactive PTY session on a remote host. Before calling this, check sshmanager.session_list for an existing session on the same host and reuse it with sshmanager.shell_run — do not open duplicate sessions. Returns SessionID and Connected.

callables.name: shell_run
callables.description: Run a command on an existing interactive SSH shell session and return the text output with exit code. Call sshmanager.session_list first to find an existing session for the target host; if none exists, open one with sshmanager.shell_open. Reuse existing sessions — do not open duplicates. Environment state (cwd, env vars, venv) is preserved across calls. A sentinel marker is appended to detect completion and capture the exit code. Not suitable for non-terminating commands (tail -f, top). TimeoutMs is in milliseconds; default 30000 (30s). Values below 1000 are clamped to the default.

callables.name: shell_stream
callables.description: Raw PTY output stream for the frontend terminal (xterm.js); one chunk per output burst, final chunk Exited=true

callables.name: status_get
callables.description: Connect to one saved SSH host and collect a live system status snapshot: load averages, memory and swap usage, CPU percent, and uptime. Connected=false when the connection fails.

callables.name: status_list
callables.description: Connect to every visible saved SSH host and collect the same system status snapshot per host as status_get (load, memory, swap, CPU, uptime); unreachable hosts report Connected=false.

callables.name: tunnel_close
callables.description: Release one reference on a tunnel opened via sshmanager.tunnel_open. When the last reference is released the local listener and SSH connection are torn down. Must be called exactly once per successful tunnel_open.

callables.name: tunnel_list
callables.description: List all live ssh -L tunnels: each tunnel's hostId, targetAddr, dialable localAddr, reference count, and in-flight forwarded connections. Use before opening a new tunnel to check whether the target is already forwarded.

callables.name: tunnel_open
callables.description: Open a local port forward (ssh -L semantics) to a target address reachable from a saved SSH host, and return the local address to dial. TargetAddr is host:port as seen from the SSH host — use "127.0.0.1:6379" to reach a service on the host's own loopback. Dial LocalAddr with any normal TCP client (redis, postgres, HTTP, …); no SSH is needed on the caller side. Tunnels are shared per (host, target): opening the same target again just adds a reference — every open must be matched by exactly one tunnel_close. Tunnels are not persisted; reopen them after a restart.

callables.name: upload
callables.description: Upload base64 content to a remote SSH session. When isArchive is true, the content is decoded as a tar.gz and extracted into the target directory (auto-created if missing). When false, the content is decoded as raw bytes and written to the target file (parent directories auto-created). Requires a sessionId from sshmanager.shell_open or an existing session.

callables.name: config_get
callables.description: Return the redacted store client config (base URL, channel, secret-presence flags).

callables.name: config_set
callables.description: Update store client config: BaseURL, Channel (dev|production), ProductionPubKey (hex Ed25519, required for production channel), AuthToken (bearer for authenticated downloads; empty falls back to the linked cloudaccount session token). Only provided fields change.

callables.name: index
callables.description: Fetch the sporecloud plugin-store index (60s TTL cache) and return store + community entries annotated with local compatibility (protocol/sdk/host-version checks).

callables.name: install
callables.description: Install from the plugin store. Kind="store": authenticated download → Ed25519 verify → AES-256-GCM decrypt → sha256 → appmanager.install_local. Kind="community": commit-pinned GitHub tarball (cloud mirror first, codeload fallback, sha256 verified) → native build from source → register. Version optional for store (default: latest compatible).

callables.name: action
callables.description: Report an action-button click on a live card; re-broadcasts the card's action payload as toast.action_triggered to subscribed windows (the target callable is NOT executed here).

callables.name: dismiss
callables.description: Remove one toast card by id and broadcast toast.card_removed.

callables.name: show
callables.description: Queue one toast card and broadcast toast.card_added to subscribed windows (frontend toast overlay).

callables.name: state
callables.description: Return the active toast card queue (oldest first) so a freshly connected window can hydrate.

callables.name: download
callables.description: Stream a URL's raw bytes to a SavePath on disk (binary-safe; parent directory created on demand). Capped at MaxBytes, default 500 MB — larger bodies are truncated with Truncated=true. Requires URL and SavePath.

callables.name: fetch
callables.description: Fetch a URL over HTTP, strip non-content HTML, and return the visible text plus page metadata. Body capped at 2 MB, extracted text at MaxChars (default 10000). Use it to read a page found by websearch.search; use websearch.download for binaries.

callables.name: search
callables.description: Web search via the active search account's provider (falls back to the default provider with an aimanager-resolved key). Returns results plus the provider id; MaxResults default 10, cap 50; optional TimeRange and Engine filters.

callables.name: attention_report
callables.description: Global awareness report: the full workbench board (every card, attention score, slot and why — hidden cards included) plus the most recent system-wide activity events (agent steps/turns, app lifecycle, user board operations). Use this to understand where the user's attention currently is before promoting/pinning/hiding cards.

callables.name: promote
callables.description: Promote a workbench card to the top of the attention ordering (user click / explicit promotion). Score becomes max + HYSTERESIS + 1.

callables.name: set_frozen
callables.description: Freeze or unfreeze the workbench layout (the ❄ mode). While frozen, score/hidden/descriptor churn no longer reflows the board — placement is held until unfrozen.

callables.name: set_hidden
callables.description: Retire or restore a workbench card (terminal summon / retreat). Restoring bumps the card's attention score.

callables.name: set_maximized
callables.description: Enter or release a full capture: with a card id the card takes the whole field until released (empty id releases). Use when the user asks to focus one thing completely.

callables.name: set_pinned
callables.description: Pin or unpin a workbench card. A pinned card is forced to the head of the ordering (main slot).

callables.name: snapshot
callables.description: Return the current workbench attention/layout snapshot: every card with its id, kind, attention score and assigned slot (main/side/term/rail/hidden). Set IncludeHidden to keep retired cards.

callables.name: upsert_card
callables.description: Declare or update a workbench card's static metadata (title, kind, icon, color, status text, visual, hidden). The actor owns score and slot.

callables.name: account
callables.description: Return the caller's identity snapshot: account id, display name, roles, and default actor context. Use it to check who the caller is acting as.

callables.name: agent_assign
callables.description: Assign a claimed task card to an existing agent: CAS backlog/todo -> doing, then hand the goal to the agent.

callables.name: agent_pause
callables.description: Pause a target agent at its next safe point (or cascade-pause its workflow children when it is a waiting owner). Only the target's direct owner, the target itself, or a human/admin may call this. Required: ToAgentId. Optional: Reason. Reversible via workspace.agent_resume.

callables.name: agent_read_message
callables.description: Read a target agent's conversation text, newest entry first. Covers all closed steps, including the active turn's already-closed AI steps; tool-call steps show the sent parameters, not results. Optional Limit (last N, default 20, max 200) and BeforeSeq (continue reading strictly older than a seq for paging). Required: ToAgentId.

callables.name: agent_resume
callables.description: Resume a paused target agent (wakes a user-paused engine or restores a paused-from-waiting owner). Same authorization as agent_pause. Required: ToAgentId. Optional: Reason.

callables.name: agent_review
callables.description: Review an agent's completed work. AgentActorId plus Decision (approve | reject). For agent callers: approve verifies the worker's branch is already merged into your worktree (git merge <branch> first), cleans up the child worktree, sets the bound task card to done, and tears the agent down; reject sets the task card back to doing, rebases the child worktree onto your branch HEAD, and resumes the agent with Feedback text. For human/admin UI callers: approve auto-merges the worker's worktree into yours. Optional TaskCardId overrides which card the status change applies to.

callables.name: agent_send_message
callables.description: Fire-and-forget delivery of text to another agent's inbox (returns immediately; the recipient processes it asynchronously). The message always reaches the recipient's LLM context: an idle agent wakes and starts a new turn for it; an agent mid-turn absorbs it as a pending submit at the next step boundary. Use it for notifications and for waking or instructing an existing agent. Required: ToAgentId, Text.

callables.name: agent_spawn_assign
callables.description: Atomically spawn a temporary agent, bind it to a task card, use that card's body as the task context, and start its first turn. Required: To (display name), AgentKind (e.g. worker), BoundTaskCardId. Optional: InterpretedGoal, MaxTurns, ProjectId, WorktreeBranch (git-safe ASCII slug for the child worktree branch; use it when task card titles contain CJK or special characters — when omitted a branch name is auto-generated). Returns AgentActorId, DisplayName, Goal.

callables.name: agent_spawn_by_type
callables.description: Spawn a short-lived fork child agent of an explicit type under the calling parent agent. Restricted: requires CallerAgentId injected by the turn engine and verified via requireActiveWorkflow.

callables.name: agent_spawn_swarm
callables.description: Spawn a persistent, card-free swarm sub-agent under the calling agent: the child self-assigns Description/Prompt as its goal, runs autonomously like a workflow worker (no task card needed), reports back via workspace.agent_send_message when done, and stays alive until terminated by the parent. The child mounts the swarm bundle itself and may spawn its own sub-agents (recursion capped at 3 levels, 8 live children per parent). Required: Description, Prompt. Optional: AgentKind (default general; read-only kinds and worker are rejected), MaxTurns, ProjectId. Returns ChildActorId, DisplayName, Depth.

callables.name: agent_terminate
callables.description: Terminate a child agent (workflow worker, fork child, or other spawned subagent). Used by the parent agent or the UI when a child fails or is unresponsive.

callables.name: component_get
callables.description: Get a component descriptor from the system meta project (resolves builtin cards).

callables.name: coordinator_peek
callables.description: Read-only Coordinator presence/nickname query answered from the agent-list snapshot; never loads (spawns) the Coordinator. Use coordinator_lookup when a live actor is required.

callables.name: create
callables.description: Create a new project: scaffold the directory and mount it as a workspace project (AppKind dev-app/sporeapp requires Path). Developer role only; rarely needed from agent flows.

callables.name: create_agent
callables.description: Create a persistent agent from an agent kind config (AgentKind required; model slots inherit the kind defaults). For workflow workers use workspace.agent_spawn_assign; for fork children use the fork tools.

callables.name: gate_approve
callables.description: Approve a workflow gate card (data.exec.kind: gate). CAS-flips the bound task card from doing to done, writes the approval record (approver, approved_at, optional form_values normalized via the request layout, optional callable_id and note) to task_outputs, and dismisses the companion-window gate toast. Authorization mirrors workspace.agent_review: trusted developer/admin identity bypasses; non-developer callers must supply a non-empty CallerAgentId that resolves to a live agent with an active workflow.

callables.name: gate_reject
callables.description: Reject a workflow gate card (data.exec.kind: gate). CAS-flips the bound task card from doing to failed and writes the rejection record (approver, rejected_at, optional reason, optional callable_id) to task_outputs, then dismisses the companion-window gate toast. Same authorization rules as workspace.gate_approve.

callables.name: host_call
callables.description: Invoke any host actor callable by dotted ID (<service>.<callable>), e.g. "workspace.slashcommands_list". The payload must match the target callable's request schema; the target's own policy still applies. Exposed by the builtin:bundle:sporecall bundle.

callables.name: list_agents
callables.description: List agents in the workspace, enriched with live status (loading/active/paused/unloaded). Use it to find agent actor IDs, check which workers are still running, and confirm an agent was torn down after review. Optional filters: Query (substring), ProjectId, ParentAgentId (only direct children of that agent), ChildrenOnly (true = shorthand for your own children).

callables.name: list_project
callables.description: List all mounted projects in the workspace with their refs, mounts, and permission modes. Use it to discover project IDs before calling project-scoped callables.

callables.name: stamp_workflow_mutating_effects
callables.description: Stamp mutating toolcall effects onto a workflow map card (data.stamped_effects) so the toolcall executor can verify plan-level approval before invoking mutating callables. Invoked by the agent's activateWorkflow after the user approves the workflow plan.

callables.name: wiki_create_card
callables.description: Create a mono card in the system meta project.

callables.name: wiki_delete_card
callables.description: Delete a mono card from the system meta project.

callables.name: wiki_edit_card
callables.description: Edit a mono card in the system meta project.

callables.name: wiki_get_card
callables.description: Get a mono card from the system meta project.

callables.name: wiki_list_cards
callables.description: List mono cards in the system meta project. Tree mode (default) renders the hierarchy under RootId as ASCII Tree + structured Nodes; Flat mode (Flat=true) returns a flat array with title Query and metadata filters, sorted by OrderBy (default -modified), paginated by Limit, with Total when Total=true.

callables.name: wiki_list_starred
callables.description: List every knowledge-base starred card across all mounted projects in one round trip. Each item carries the owning ProjectID/ProjectName plus the CardID, projects in mount order and cards most-recently-starred first. Unreachable projects are skipped.

callables.name: wiki_search_card_content
callables.description: Search mono cards in the system meta project by body content (substring or /regexp/), with optional tags/status/type/source filters. Returns matching cards with a snippet and line number of the first match, and an untruncated Total.

callables.name: workflow_start
callables.description: Start a workflow map on an existing agent: mount the agent when unloaded, activate the workflow (claims map ownership), then kick off the first orchestration turn.
